query_loki_logs.note: The previous LogQL returned zero rows on every run because the OTLP body is a JSON string nested inside `body`; a single `| json` stage never exposed `delivery_id`. The query now reparses after `line_format` and the agents finally receive the real FFmpeg stderr.

tempo_get-trace.note: The span no longer carries the injected scenario or the delivery title.

alerting_manage_rules.note: A Grafana-managed alert rule is provisioned per delivery at creation, by SLATE and not by Gemini.

create_annotation.precondition: written only after an operator approves a remediation

get_panel_image.read_by: gemini-2.5-flash on Vertex AI, as an inline image part
get_panel_image.note: Grafana renders the panel, MCP carries the PNG, Gemini describes the chart. The reading is commentary and can never become a verdict.

deterministic_gate_proof.note: One window cannot open an incident. The third window satisfied all three thresholds.

enforced_by: tests/test_classify.py asserts the classifier source contains no reference to fault_mode
tests/test_classify.py asserts the measurement path (_transcode, _attempt, _qc, run) contains none either
tests/test_pipeline.py asserts no emitted job result contains the scenario name
classifier_proof.note: Deterministic failures are not retried; only timeout and unclassified are, once.

adk_proof.diagnosis_corroborated_from: FFmpeg stderr quoted out of Loki, plus the Prometheus failure counter and the Tempo span tree

remediation_loop_proof.note: An operator may only approve an option the agent actually proposed.

board_state.note: Stale duplicate judge-proof records were deleted along with their Grafana alert rules.

visual_check.narrow_500: clean; single column, no horizontal scroll
visual_check.note: Edge headless on Windows will not lay out below roughly 500 CSS px, so a 390px capture is a crop of a 500px layout rather than a page defect.

tests.skipped_reason: FFmpeg-dependent; CI installs FFmpeg and runs them

limitations: The delivery receiver remains simulated; ingest, FFmpeg, QC, packaging, telemetry and agent calls are real.
Five classifier scenarios is engineering evidence, not a statistical accuracy claim.
Schedule histories in the benchmark's gate_evaluation are constructed fixtures.
Lead time is a projection from a measured p95 onto a stated delivery size.
The stack is self-hosted Grafana OSS; Grafana Cloud-only features are unavailable and unused.
